label_status: Conform - all requirements are fulfilled; permanent TISAX labels are received and the assessment result may be published on the exchange platform
Minor non-conform - at least one minor non-conformity exists; temporary TISAX labels can be received on the basis of a corrective action plan assessment report until all non-conformities are resolved
Major non-conform - at least one major non-conformity exists (or non-conformities exist without an approved corrective action plan); no TISAX labels are received until the issue is resolved
